pages.text: Two ordinary $(l:companions/transport)Transport Slimes$() form a colony through $(l:world/colony_bonding)Colony Bonding$(). A visible cord links their two moving bodies. Both retain their identities. New and recovered deployments start in Wait.
pages.title: Transport Slime Colony

pages.text: The bodies move separately within the cord’s reach and divide cargo collection, unloading and supply deliveries. They share one bag and order. Capacity is the sum of both members’ real capacities, including their ordinary Transport bonuses.

Either body opens management; Wait stops both. Health and stamina are shared. Unused points start at their mean rounded down. One point upgrades each uncapped member. Growth is half rate while any role stat can upgrade both; otherwise normal. Recover and unbind to return both in Wait with their traits, each receiving the shared point balance.
